caution_findings.evidence_context: Fig. 4 curve-level viability values were not digitized; Table 3 IC50 and no-obvious-activity cells are preserved as the supported row-level outputs.
The paper reports human glioma cell viability / IC50 assays for stapled peptide PROTACs, not microbial MIC/MBC activity.

Primary Table 1 reports Ac-/Ahx-/S5-/NH2-modified stapled peptide sequences. DBAASP sequence rows encode noncanonical Ahx/S5 positions with X and omit terminal Ac/NH2 notation, so modification notation is preserved rather than silently normalized.
DBAASP linked rows are target_activity IC50 rows for human glioblastoma cell lines, not microbial AMP activity rows.
The final mechanism claim is supported by molecular docking text/figures for MDM2/MDMX binding context; the repaired owned layers do not add a direct degradation assay.
